evidence_findings.title: Post-Sale Defect Escalation in Triage Meeting (M07) vs Pipeline Tracking
evidence_findings.observation: Customer A demonstrated four critical billing and reimbursement bugs on screen.
evidence_findings.productDecision: Built a multi-route model pairing Customer Follow-up with Sales Coaching/Support Escalation.

evidence_findings.title: Discrepancy Between Telephony Metadata and Spoken Caller Identity (C06)
evidence_findings.observation: Rep name was recorded as Meera, but caller introduced himself as Ravi.
evidence_findings.productDecision: Surfaced both stored metadata and verbal transcript identification side-by-side.

evidence_findings.title: Strict Regulatory Compliance Boundary in Partner Discovery (M01)
evidence_findings.observation: Partner sought individual accounts; rep clarified SpendNest requires registered US business entities.
evidence_findings.productDecision: Separated Partner Coordination from sales routing and established qualification boundaries.

rejected_decision.title: Deliberately Rejecting Automated Pipeline Currency Totaling & Win-Rate Forecasting
rejected_decision.rejectedAlternative: Synthesizing deal values and stage forecasts from conversational numbers.
rejected_decision.whyRejected: DATA_DICTIONARY strictly prohibits inventing revenue or pipeline totals without authoritative CRM tables.
rejected_decision.tradeOffAccepted: No speculative revenue numbers; 100% verifiable operational intelligence.
